lane_title: Chi across-strike sign-reversal + slope-break + basin gate
submission_note: CHIASM chi-slope-basin 37654 dots; HOLDOUT-DTI 0.0671; UNSCORED; DO NOT SUBMIT

hypothesis.statement: Buried intrabasin scarps offset drainages and reorganize upstream catchments, yielding a signed chi step across strike that persists where surface scarp is eroded; chi contrast is hydrologic, independent of potential-field layers.
hypothesis.layers: dem10_chi_100m_u8 chan_n (chi step_max) + det_elev_slope Hessian ridge + depth_to_base_surf basin gate + det_elev
hypothesis.physical_signature: Local chi opposite-side contrast at 300m (max over 4 dirs) detrended vs 1500m, co-located with slope-break ridge and basin-cover gate, directional NMS crest pool, spaced emission
hypothesis.off_catalogue_rationale: Intrabasin faults behead catchments and shift chi even where USGS catalogue is incomplete under alluvium; slope-break confirms scarp, depth gate excludes range-front bedrock.
hypothesis.non_fault_mimic: Lithologic knickzone or volcanic flow margin producing chi step without slope-break; pluvial shoreline bench at constant elevation
hypothesis.difference_from_repo: PROVCREST uses magnitude Hessians; ADHR uses scalar chi; none uses signed opposite-flank chi reversal conditioned on slope-break and basin gate

mechanism: chi_u8 chan_n smoothed sigma2 -> opposite-side 300m contrast (4 dirs, both flanks in footprint) × percentile-ranked det_elev_slope Hessian ridge (sigma1.5) × basin depth gate (0.3+0.7*rank(depth_to_base_surf)); percentile-rank surface; directional NMS 3x3 max; greedy spaced emission 3.5px, >3px from catalogue, border 6px; binary float32 on exact sample grid
named_non_fault_process: Lithologic knickzone producing chi step without coincident slope-break; Lake Lahontan shoreline bench (constant elevation, not transverse)
